# Portable refusal must precede every HTTP method; this peer runs no backend.
! skygo run -f mounts.yaml
stderr 'require.*--remote-data|--remote-data.*require'
! skygo run --remote-data -f unknown.yaml
stderr 'field read_onli not found'
! skygo run --remote-data -f overlap.yaml
stderr 'overlapping data mount'
! skygo run --remote-data -f no-target.yaml
stderr 'explicit.*target|target.*explicit'
! skygo run --remote-data -f plain.yaml
stderr 'workdir|mount'
! skygo plan --remote-data --objective lowest-rate --currency USD -f mounts.yaml
stderr 'remote.data|remote data'
calls ALL 0
! exists native-marker

-- mounts.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
target: data
directory: /task
data_mounts:
  - reference: dataset-z
    destination: /mnt/skygo/z
    read_only: false
  - reference: dataset-a
    destination: /mnt/skygo/a
    read_only: true

-- unknown.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
target: data
directory: /task
data_mounts:
  - reference: dataset-z
    destination: /mnt/skygo/z
    read_onli: false
  - reference: dataset-a
    destination: /mnt/skygo/a
    read_only: true

-- overlap.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
target: data
directory: /task
data_mounts:
  - reference: dataset-z
    destination: /mnt/skygo/a/child
    read_only: false
  - reference: dataset-a
    destination: /mnt/skygo/a
    read_only: true

-- no-target.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
directory: /task
data_mounts:
  - reference: dataset-z
    destination: /mnt/skygo/z
    read_only: false
  - reference: dataset-a
    destination: /mnt/skygo/a
    read_only: true

-- plain.yaml --
argv: [echo, hello]
target: local
